tools.name: tide_times
tools.description: High tide and low tide times and heights (a tide table) for a US coastal place or NOAA station, today or any date, from NOAA tide predictions. location takes a place ("Santa Cruz, CA"), a NOAA station id (9414290) or lat,lon. Up to 31 days per call.

tools.name: tide_now
tools.description: Is the tide coming in or going out right now at a US coastal place? Returns rising or falling, the estimated current height, and the time and height of the next high and next low tide, from NOAA predictions.

tools.name: low_tide_windows
tools.description: Find the low tides at or below a height over the coming days, marked daylight or dark, for tide pooling, clamming, beach access or launching a boat. Up to 90 days ahead.

tools.name: tide_stations_search
tools.description: Find NOAA tide prediction stations by name ("Monterey", "Bar Harbor, ME") or nearest to lat,lon, with station id, state, type and distance. Use the id with the other tide tools when a place name is ambiguous.
